# {This algorithm dynamically scales GLS edge penalties by incorporating the tour edge length coefficient of variation and local utilization stagnation to adaptively penalize high-utility edges across diverse instance topologies.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    
    mean_len = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    std_len = np.std(tour_lengths)
    
    # Compute coefficient of variation to detect non-uniform/clustered distributions
    cv = std_len / (mean_len + 1e-12)
    
    # Account for stagnation via average tour edge reuse
    mean_count = np.mean(tour_counts)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + np.tanh(mean_count / 10.0)
    
    # Adaptively scale penalty parameter between clustered and uniform geometries
    alpha = np.clip(0.1 + 0.35 * cv, 0.15, 0.65) * stagnation_factor
    penalty = alpha * mean_len
    
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
